title: Move a conducting rod faster
hook: Change rod speed and predict motional emf magnitude.
misconception: motional emf magnitude stays fixed when rod speed doubles.
objective: Apply emf = BLv to compare motional emf magnitude when rod speed changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a rod moving perpendicular to its length and a fixed uniform magnetic field with fixed length, emf = BLv. When rod speed doubles, motional emf magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model emf = BLv; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a rod moving perpendicular to its length and a fixed uniform magnetic field with fixed length, with a nonzero initial result. If rod speed triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on motional emf magnitude?
recall.why: Apply emf = BLv under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
